scope.summary: Execute and retain the complete Tailor visual, accessibility, responsive-layout, failure-state, large-data, device-loss, and human-plus-agent concurrency matrix.
acceptance_criteria: Required panes cover empty/loading/error/large-data, normal/failure/recovery, narrow/HDPI/theme/high-contrast/reduced-motion, and keyboard/Argus states.
Every cell retains screenshot, AccessKit tree, typed state, command trace, error scan, receipt, focus/selection ids, and repro route.
Matrix completeness and image/state references are machine-checked; visual verdicts require opening the exact captures.

The native suite proves Tailor pane and typed-command registration, shared wgpu context, stable AccessKit identities/actions, Argus inspection/steering/capture, quiet background behavior, and absence of positive legacy web execution paths after MT-688 passes.

The exact TailorSurfaceDescriptor row MT-708 enumerates every route, pane, control author_id, dynamic entity-key rule, action, state, help anchor, permission, undo policy, receipt, and command binding; wildcard-only evidence is rejected.

Applicable blank, loading, populated, stale/conflict, cancelled, failed, retry, permission, keyboard/focus, narrow/4K/DPI, overlap/clipping, and no-focus-steal states are covered by the registry-derived Argus matrix.

The matrix is generated from TailorSurfaceDescriptor rows and fails on wildcard-only targets, duplicate/orphan/unreachable controls, missing commands or help anchors, row-position IDs, and controls without permission, undo, receipt, and state coverage.
scope.risk_if_missed: A handful of screenshots cannot prove a complex professional GUI remains readable and operable.

target_entries: Tailor UserManual > Tailor workspace and controls

hbr_int_009_tier_obligations.reason: This MT is observed through the canonical command, job, or artifact owner; it must preserve correlation identifiers and must not create a second event authority.
This MT must wire the shared internal_diagnostics API for its native, job, device, solver-run, or DCC failure modes with bounded structured evidence.
Long-running, native, or external-process work must register bounded progress and child/process identity with the shared Palmistry watcher; Tailor must not fork a watcher.

risks: Broad MT scope can hide multiple review targets.
Markdown MT lists may disagree with packet-declared active/next MT truth.
Receipt routing may target an old MT if contract identity is omitted.
minimum_controls: Exactly one primary proof target per MT unless the packet records why not.
MT identity must be stable and referenced by receipt correlation.
Generated projection drift must not wake Coder or Validator by itself.

required_changes_before_execution: Consume the signed technical refinement, canonical command/surface registries, classified HBR tiers, and task-oriented UserManual contract before execution.
